fusions.name: Held for the Others
fusions.desc: A clamping bite that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Wrench Loose
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A twisting bite that deals 9 damage and leaves it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hauled by the Scruff
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 conditions from you and every ally near you.

fusions.name: Never Lets Go
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
